other_conditions: tumbling: tau_m = 8.93 ± 0.03 ns (axial, D|/D_perp = 1.20 ± 0.02); tau_m rises to 13.26 ± 0.04 ns at 1.85 mM from 8.90 ± 0.03 ns at 0.1 mM (self-association above 0.1 mM); S2 = 0.83 ± 0.02 (helix 1 average); R2/R1 for helix 1 is 11.0 at 61 MHz and 19.4 at 81 MHz versus 8.6 and 14.5 elsewhere; regime (authors): millisecond time scale exchange; 7 of 14 helix 1 residues (L21, T22, K23, Q24, M25, V29, S31) flagged by the RDC plot; related structures: refined rat OMP NMR structure and mouse OMP X-ray structure, no PDB ids given
timescale: Rex = 2.4 ± 0.3 s-1 (helix 1 average, 61 MHz); Rex = 1.76 ± 0.42 s-1 (Asp20) to 2.94 ± 0.47 s-1 (Gln24) per residue (all helix 1 residues fit with model 3, per-residue fit)
caveat_note: No BMRB entry; sheet lists 298.5 K and 600/800 MHz, paper measured at 37 °C, pH 6.6 at 600 and 800 MHz, so the temperature differs from the sheet value. author_claim: Helix 1 is rigid on the picosecond-nanosecond scale (S2 0.83) but shows uniform millisecond exchange broadening (Rex about 2.4 s-1), consistent with its poor packing and few long-range NOEs.
